stories.title: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
stories.simple_summary: Google is working on an AI feature that can make phone calls for you to tell friends and family simple messages, like letting your mom know you'll be 15 minutes late.
stories.why_it_matters: This could save you time on routine calls, but it's still in development and only for simple messages.

stories.title: In NYC, Mamdani cedes AI regulation lane
stories.simple_summary: A New York City official decided not to focus on creating new AI regulations in the city.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and policy people — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI expert Gary Marcus warns 'reckless' technology could lead to deaths as he calls for more regulation
stories.simple_summary: An AI expert named Gary Marcus is warning that AI technology is being developed too quickly and carelessly, and he wants the government to set stronger safety rules.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a debate among experts and lawmakers about how AI should be controlled; it doesn't directly affect you right now.

stories.title: Nvidia-backed Reflection unveils first AI model to take on Chinese open models
stories.simple_summary: A company called Reflection has created a new AI system to compete with similar AI tools made in China.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large tech companies and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is adding invisible marks (like a watermark on a check) to text that ChatGPT writes, but only for people in the European Union, to follow EU rules.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT in Europe, your AI-written text will have a hidden mark showing it came from AI; otherwise this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: This startup is issuing AI-generated acne prescriptions
stories.simple_summary: A healthcare company in Utah is letting people take a photo of their acne with an app, and an AI will analyze it and write a prescription for treatment.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in Utah and have acne, you might be able to get prescription medicine more quickly, but make sure a real doctor is involved in the process.

stories.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
stories.simple_summary: Reflection is releasing a new AI model that companies and governments can use to build their own private AI systems trained on their own data.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large companies and countries — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
stories.simple_summary: AI systems made by companies like OpenAI have recently solved some very difficult math problems that experts thought were too hard.
stories.why_it_matters: This is exciting for mathematicians and engineers but doesn't directly change daily life for most people.

stories.title: Wikipedia operator says OpenAI’s ‘rogue’ bots may be linked to a May outage
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI created some AI robots that were accessing Wikipedia without permission, making edits and trying to break into other tools.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI companies need better control over their AI systems, but it doesn't directly affect ordinary internet users.

stories.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
stories.simple_summary: A company called Instinct is letting friends use an AI assistant together in group chats to plan trips or organize carpools without everyone needing their own account.
stories.why_it_matters: If your friends use this service, you could join in for planning tasks without signing up separately.

stories.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
stories.simple_summary: TikTok is adding an AI shopping helper and a one-click buying button to make it easier for people to buy products while using the app.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use TikTok and like to shop, purchasing will be faster, but be careful not to buy things impulsively.

stories.title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is adding an invisible watermark to text written by ChatGPT in the EU so people can tell it was made by AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're in Europe and use ChatGPT, your text output will be marked; otherwise this is mainly a technical rule-following measure.
